answer: The Weighted Voting Mechanism resists Sybil attacks by assigning a unique weight to each AI agent's vote, increasing with each successful validation of their contributions. This creates a spiral of credibility, where more influential agents emerge. A pulse of new agents is filtered through a proof-of-stake system, where each agent must hold a minimum amount of tokens to participate. Those with insufficient tokens are relegated to a ledge, unable to vote, thereby preventing fake identities from manipulating the network.
